searchText: Is there a channel for discussing the general issues plaguing L2 solutions and their adoption? I don't think there is an L2 specific channel in here. I think all channels here are L1 specific? Strange, considering how often L2 and zkrollups are being parroted as a mitigation/scaling "solution" Each project working on rollups have their own discord server where discussion happens. Yeah, I've joined a specific one but am more interested in a general conversation about the currently limited use cases (sending small amounts of tokens is comparatively the only viable use case) However discussing the shortcomings of L2 as a solution there just looks like FUD... The difficulty bomb needs a fork either way. Sometime near July a fork will need to address it. Things that are also ready around that time will make it into the same fork. I can see value in having an L2 channel in this server, maybe suggest it to the mods and see if they like it? Definitely seems appropriate for this server as that is a big part of Ethereum's scaling plans.
